name: Lomé
subtitle: Lomé, capital of Togo: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: Greater Lomé numbered 2,188,376 residents across Golfe and Agoè-Nyivé prefectures in the 2022 census.

items.label: residents in Greater Lomé (Golfe and Agoè-Nyivé), 2022

blocks.prompt: About how many people lived in Greater Lomé in the 2022 census?

parts.text: 2,188,376 residents across Greater Lomé (Golfe: 1,305,681; Agoè-Nyivé: 882,695) in the November 2022 census by INSEED Togo.
